prompt: An explosive feral power-up in place. Drop into a deep wide-legged crouch, hunch the shoulders and pull both fists down beside the hips. Snap the torso forward with a snarling head thrust, jerk shoulders and clenched fists through short savage trembling pulses, then arch back roaring with fists driven low and outward. Keep both feet planted throughout. Existing glove flames whip upward violently. Hold the tense hunched roaring charge at the end. No punch, no projectile, no transformation, no walking. Fixed camera.
